name: Online Research Costs
description: Puts equipment research back to what it cost in the online game: the materials crafting and upgrades take (mostly two to four times the offline amounts), and their SPLithium.
author: S3er0i9ng

settings.label: Online material counts
settings.help: How many of each material crafting a part and each upgrade take, as online. For most recipes that is two to four times the offline amount.

settings.label: Online SPLithium costs
settings.help: The SPLithium crafting and upgrades cost, as online. Most are double the offline cost; a few are half.
